description: Matrix exponential (general, skew-symmetric, scaled 1-norm) and integer power of the squares 1..6 (WP 8.5-P17)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: exp1
ops.doc: a.exp() (upstream's Padé approximant with scaling and squaring), general a
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: exp1_scaled
ops.doc: a.exp() (upstream's Padé approximant with scaling and squaring), a with entries uniform in (-1, 1) rescaled to a 1-norm uniform in [3, 12] (scaling and squaring)
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
